recentItems.description:

Starring Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, PRACTICAL MAGIC 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all in a must-see cinematic event of fun, magic and mayhem.

recentItems.title: Little Shop of Horrors 4K | Seymour’s TV Interview Goes Horribly Wrong | Warner Bros. Entertainment
recentItems.description:
Little Shop of Horrors in 4K shows Seymour Krelborn’s strange rise from overlooked flower shop assistant to celebrated plant scientist begins to fall apart when Audrey II collapses during a television interview in this official movie clip from Little Shop of Horrors. 

Now known across the country for his extraordinary plant, Seymour is expected to explain the phenomenon that made him famous, but the cameras arrive at the worst possible moment. When the host asks him to feed Audrey II, Seymour knows he cannot reveal the disturbing truth about the plant’s unusual appetite. 

Seymour becomes increasingly frantic and orders everyone out of the shop. Even Audrey cannot calm him down before he escapes into the alley, knowing he must find a way to feed Audrey II before the truth is exposed.

recentItems.description:
Watch this Leonardo DiCaprio-packed compilation featuring the most iconic scenes from The Departed.

Two men from opposite sides of the law, an undercover cop and a mole within the police department, race to uncover each other's identity before their own secrets are revealed. Watch The Departed on Digital now!

ABOUT The Departed:
Martin Scorsese directs an all-star cast in this action-packed thriller set in Boston, where a long-simmering hostility between the police department and an Irish-American gang led by Costello (Academy Award winner Jack Nicholson--About Schmidt, Something's Gotta Give) is primed to explode. The fuse is lit when a gangster (Matt Damon--The Bourne Identity, The Bourne Supremacy) is chosen to infiltrate the police force--and a young cop (Leonardo DiCaprio--The Aviator, Titanic) goes undercover within the gang. Now, when the two moles uncover each other's identity, the battle begins.​
